_comment: Soldier companion (content pass C6, plan-content-zones12.md §B): the summon behind Call for Aid — three soldiers of the front answer the horn. Companion pattern verbatim (owned, caster-aligned follower; spawnSummon overrides faction from the caster, hence no faction key; never a zone spawn): collisionLayer 160 = Viewport|Player, collisionMask 17 = PlayerStatic|Border, speed above the player's so it keeps up, role follower (authored since chunk 2); aggroRadius 3.5 [PLACEHOLDER], inert while it rides owner combat signals. curveLevel 1 — power comes from SummonPower x f(ownerLevel), not the curve. Reuses SoldierBlades (the ArmySoldier kit): the summon IS a soldier. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
